title: 日本ダービーの後に・魅力を伝える舞台

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky has a great time running the Japanese Derby, a race that Umamusume only run once in their lives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I suggest that she challenge the Arima Kinen next, the best place to show her running to the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The suggestion surprises her, but she agrees and sets her sights on the Arima Kinen.
